title: Wire the global stylesheet and design fonts into the root layout
prompt: Write src/app/styles-wired-in-layout.tsx, a Next.js root layout with a default export function RootLayout that takes children. Import the global stylesheet from ./globals.css. Load the two design fonts named in docs/design/tokens.json with next/font/google: Bricolage_Grotesque and Figtree. Give each font the variable option name: --font-bricolage for Bricolage Grotesque and --font-figtree for Figtree. Render an html element with lang set to en and a className that carries both font variable class names, and a body element that renders children.
